info.title: Quartermaster AI + TrustRail API
info.summary: AI procurement for restaurants, with deterministic spend controls and PayPal sandbox payments.
info.description: Autonomous procurement secured by TrustRail. Amounts are integer minor units (cents). Sign in with `POST /auth/login` (or `/auth/signup`): the API sets an httpOnly session cookie. Every mutation requires the header `X-Requested-With: quartermaster`; routes marked idempotent also require an `Idempotency-Key`. Errors share one shape (`ApiError`) with a stable `code`.

session.name: qm_session
session.description: Session cookie set by sign-in (named `__Host-qm_session` on HTTPS deployments).

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: A unique key per user action; retries with the same key return the first result.

Csrf.name: X-Requested-With
Csrf.description: CSRF guard: must be `quartermaster` on every mutation.

email_enabled.description: Outbound email is configured: invitations and reset links are emailed.

sample_accounts_hint.description: Show the shared sample-workspace accounts on the sign-in page.

operator.description: Platform operator (OPERATOR_EMAILS): may see system-wide error tracking.

InvitationPreviewDto.description: What someone opening an invitation link sees before accepting.

search_query.description: Editable details (PUT /inventory/:id round-trips them). Optional until every API build sends them; the edit form treats a missing value as blank.

quarantined.description: Flagged by injection screening: withheld from the agent, and TrustRail blocks carts with it.

MembersResponse.description: `GET /members`. Invitations are listed for owners only (empty otherwise).

InvitationCreatedResponse.description: `POST /members/invitations`. The link is returned to the owner so it can be shared even when no email provider is configured; it is never retrievable again.

ResetLinkResponse.description: `POST /members/:id/password-reset` (managers and viewers only). When the link was emailed to the member, `reset_url` is null; otherwise it is the one-time link for the owner to pass on.

revoked_certificates.description: Active intent certificates revoked because they were signed under the previous version.

WebhookAckResponse.description: `POST /webhooks/paypal`: acknowledgement PayPal receives for a verified event.

spend_by_supplier.description: Captured spend net of refunds, per supplier, largest first.

unconfirmed_captures_7d.description: Completed captures in the last 7 days with no verified PayPal notification.

PayPalNotificationStatusDto.description: Whether PayPal's signed notifications (webhooks) are reaching this deployment for an organisation.

BadRequest.description: The request failed validation (`BAD_REQUEST`, details list each field).

Unauthorized.description: Not signed in, or the session expired (`UNAUTHENTICATED`).

Forbidden.description: The signed-in role is too low (`ROLE_REQUIRED`) or the CSRF header is missing.

Conflict.description: The request conflicts with current state; see `code`.

NotFound.description: No such resource in your workspace.
